args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt was a partial failure (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed us-west and eu-west. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all three regions with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: investigate the orchestrator partial-failure and root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.
